summary: This is a configuration file that defines settings for a server. It specifies that the server should listen on port 8080 and bind to the localhost address, which means it will only accept connections from the same machine it's running on.

explanations.1: The square brackets create a section header called 'server' — this groups related configuration settings together so you can have multiple sections like [database] or [logging] in the same file.
explanations.2: This sets the port number to 8080, which is the 'address' the server listens on for incoming connections.
explanations.3: This sets the host to localhost, meaning the server will only accept connections from the local machine (127.0.0.1) rather than from other computers on a network.
